score_report_meta_description: Send the score of the match you are watching.
score_report_closed: This match is not accepting scores because it has not started yet or finished too long ago.
score_report_banned: You cannot submit scores because you were temporarily blocked until {when}. Reason: {reason}. If you believe this is a mistake, contact us through the official channels.
score_report_why_location_title: Why do we ask for location?
score_report_why_location_p1: We use your location only at the moment you submit the score, to confirm the information comes from someone watching the match at the ground and improve data quality.
score_report_why_location_p2: If you do not share your location, you can still submit scores — they will just carry less weight. We always recommend allowing location.
score_report_why_location_p3: Domingo às Dez does not continuously track your location. It only receives it at the instant of submission. The project source code is open on GitHub.
score_report_disclaimer: Do not send false scores. Scores are not updated directly without review first. Besides being childish behaviour, you can be blocked automatically at the end of the match. Value grassroots football — be a positive contributor.
score_report_login_captcha: Sign in so you do not have to solve the captcha
score_report_error_closed: This match is not accepting scores because it has not started yet or has already finished.
score_report_error_banned: You are temporarily blocked and cannot submit scores.
score_report_error_duplicate: You already sent this score and do not need to do it again. Thanks for contributing.
score_report_error_recent: You already sent a score recently. Try again later.
score_report_error_recent_ip: We already have many reports from your network in the last few minutes. Try again later.
score_report_error_captcha: Confirm you are not a robot to continue.
